bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/de yang rlangs dpal gyi seṅge'i zhal nas/lar skyes pa'i mis rang gi skye rgyud ma shes na nags khung gi spre'u dang 'dra/mi rang gi

tei:div.tei:p: bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/de yang rlangs dpal gyi seṅge'i zhal nas/ lar skyes pa'i mis rang gi skye rgyud ma shes na nags khung gi spre'u dang 'dra/ mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na g.yu 'brug zol ma dang 'dra/ yab mes kyi che dge'i yig tshang ma shes na mon phrug yal bor dang 'dra/ zhes pa ltar/ rang gi skye rgyud ma shes na nags khrod kyi spre'u ltar gzhan gyis mthong med pa dang*/ cho 'brang ma shes na sprin dang bral ba'i g.yu 'brug ltar phan btags kyi skyor ya dkon zhing*/ yab mes kyi lo rgyus ma shes na yal bor ba'i mon phrug ltar gzhan gyis mthong chung bya yul du 'gyur zhing*/ shes na skyon de dag dang bral nas ldog phyogs yon tan rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ltar na/ rang rigs blo gsal gyi gzhon nu rnams kyis 'das don gyi lo rgyus shog lhe re re nas bslab bya re blangs te ma 'ongs pa'i kha phyogs yang dag pa zhig btsal rgyu'i re ba dang*/ dpyod ldan rnams kyis bod kyi lo rgyus la mtha' dpyod kyi gsos su smon nas nged zhib 'jug khang gis da lan dpe bskrun byas pa'i yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed 'di ni/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang*/<dpe rtags phyi ra203gt;nang bzhugs rgyal rabs gong ma'i legs bshad rnam dbye yid 'dzin lta bde go gsal rgya bod kyi yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed kyi mchod brjod bzhugs zhes dang*/ yang 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang*/ <dpe rtags phyi ra1273gt;nang bzhugs kyi dpe gcig la rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba dang*/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi gna' rabs dpe cha legs sgrig dang dpe skrun gyi 'char 'god 'go khrid tshogs chung gis spar slog brgyab pa'i dpe gcig si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa rgya bod yig tshang chen mo bcas ma dpe bzhi lag son byung ba'i nang nas da lam 'dir 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang <phyi ra 1273gt;nang bzhugs

<rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba > 'di legs cha che bar mthong bas 'di la gzhi bcol te/ ma dpe'i yig 'bru mi gsal ba dang skung yig bkrol dka' ba rnams gzhung gong 'og dang*/ dpe mi 'dra ba khag bzhi zhib bsdur thog 'phyugs med du bkral zhing*/ phrad sbyor yig nor mngon gsal dag bcos pa phud/ brda dag mi mthun pa rnams dpe gzhan gsum dang brda dag gi bstan bcos rnams la gtugs nas bo dong zla ba lags dang mnyam por zhu dag thengs gnyis dang*/ slar yang tha ma'i zhu chen pa khams sprul bsod nams don grub lags kyis kyang ming tshig dang tha snyad spyi'i brda gsar rnying bcas dag par byas pa'i yig tshang 'di yang mi chos kyi lo rgyus te/ 'dzam gling spyi dang bod kyi lo rgyus rus rgyud kyi skor dang*/ rgya bod hor gsum gyi rgyal rabs dang*/ lha chos kyi byung tshul la/ bod du bstan pa phyi dar skabs/ mkhas grub sdai dgon byung tshul/ rngog lo khu dbon gyi slob rgyud dang bshad grwa dar tshul/ shangs pa bka' brgyud rin chen bdun byon tshul sogs lugs gnyis char gyi don so sor bstan cing*/ gzhan yang deb ther gzhan las mthong ba nyung ba'i ja dang dkar yol byung tshul sogs gzigs rgyang yangs pa'i dpyod ldan rnams la blo gros kyi sgo mo phye ba'i lde mig tu snang*/ ma dpe bzhi las 'bras spungs kyi dpe gnyis ni skabs 'ga' mchan dkyus la shor ram snyam pa tsam dang*/ yang skabs la lar tshig don mi 'dra ba'i cha dang rgyas bsdus cung zad mngon yang rtsa ba'i cha gcig mtshungs dang*/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i <rgya bod yig tshang chen mo >zhes pa ni krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mos spar slog brgyab pa'i dpe de nyid ma dpe byas pa mngon zhing*/ de dang 'bras spungs kyi dpe gnyis bsdur na tshig don dang*/ rgyas sdus la he bag che tsam yod par brten/

dpon yig dpal 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa'i yig tshang rgyas bsdus mang du yod par gsungs pa las/ da lam nga tshor ma dpe mi 'dra ba gsum lag son byung ba rnams la rgyas bsdus dang go rim mi 'dra ba'i cha mang du mchis pa las/ da lan 'dir dpon yig dpal 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba 'di dang*/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod bdun bcas dpe dkon khag cig nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa'i dpe tshogs kyi khongs su par skrun zhus pa 'di'i/ ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang dpe sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa karma bde legs dang*/ spyi khyab las ka'i 'gan khur ba mkhan po 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song dpal brtsegs las khungs nas zhus shing*/ par skrun gyi 'gro song ches brin bod sman khang nas btang ba dang*/ rtsis 'khor deb sgrig pa tshe ring sgrol ma/ skal bzang lha mo/ shes rab dpal g.yang*/ ye shes chos mtsho sogs kyis bgyis te rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba lags/
zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas thub bstan nyi mas so// // PAGE bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ PAGE -PAGE 6--PAGE 5-
